messages:
michael: FYI saw a short but noisy per-token burn spike for route r-310 during last night's model swap. tokens/sec steady but unit-cost forecast blew past the budget for ~12m. Not a long outage but triggered a bunch of pager noise.
sara: saw the same. the new model landed on a different SKU pool and cache lineage didn't transfer, so the effective per-token charge jumped. the cost dashboard shows a flat line increase which confused PMs.
leo: can we add a "forecasted rollback" safety panel to the rollout UI? idea: before promoting, show a 30/60/120m forecast with a projected burn and an option to attach a rollback budget. if forecasted burn > budget we flash a warning and optionally auto-rollback.
tara: love that. requires two infra pieces: 1) telemetry that tags token samples with billing_bucket (sku_id or bucket tag) + route_priority so we can compute bucketed unit cost, 2) a near-real-time forecast job that consumes recent samples and outputs short-horizon burn estimates per route+bucket.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: recommend enabling higher sample_weight for events that cross buckets for 1 hour after deploy to reduce estimator variance.
michael: example telemetry event i propose (simple line protocol):
  token_sample route=r-310 sku=sku-gpu-v100 bucket=hotpath billing_bucket=sku-gpu-v100 model=phoenix-8k canary=true tokens=24 cache_hit=false sample_weight=10
sara: for the UI card sketch: 
  - Projected burn (30m/60m/120m) with confidence bands
  - "Rollback budget" numeric field in modal (default empty)
  - Toggle: auto-rollback if projected_burn > budget for > N minutes
  - Inline link to cost drilldown showing SKU buckets and cache lineage
leo: we should also expose a "bucketed unit cost" column in the per-route table so ops can quickly spot routes routing to expensive SKU buckets. that avoids chasing paging noise.
tara: backend note: forecast job can be a small streaming aggregator that takes token samples, expands by sample_weight, and projects burn using a short autoregressive model over token mix + cache_hit trajectory. keep latency < 15s for freshness.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: to save ingest costs, implement adaptive sampling: full sample_weight for canaries and multi-sku events; baseline sampling elsewhere. also add a small change to sample schema: include route_owner_team string so console links to owner.
michael: action items: 1) telemetry schema update (add billing_bucket, route_priority, route_owner_team, sample_weight guidance) -> tara/metrics. 2) small streaming forecast service + API for rollout modal -> leo/infra. 3) console UI: rollout card + bucketed unit cost column + rollback budget control -> sara/ux. i'll open RFC and tag infra/telemetry/ux.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: RFC created: RFC-2481 forecast-rollback-budget-and-bucketed-billing (michael)
sara: i'll mock the card tomorrow and post in #design for quick feedback.
leo: i can prototype the forecast API shape next sprint.
michael: thanks everyone, if we get this live it should cut a lot of noisy pages and make billing surprises visible to the person flipping the switch.
